description: selects reproducible words from a caller list for non-secret labels using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded seeded passphrase words result when an agent needs a reproducible decision that another run can independently replay. Returns the deterministic selection plus seed provenance, population bounds, and the operation-specific outcome for Seeded Passphrase Words as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Uses Python pseudorandomness for reproducibility, not cryptography, lotteries with value, security tokens, gambling, or custody.
